en: A black-and-white image of a broad street in a European town, lined with early 20th-century buildings and small trees. The street appears to be dirt or gravel, not paved, and people (mostly women and children in period clothing) are walking or standing about. Toward the back right, there is a church with a pointed steeple visible above the trees. The architecture features steeply pitched roofs and gables, characteristic of northern or central European towns. There are no modern vehicles present, only a horse-drawn cart.
